findings.title: Humanitarian Situation Report | 26 November 2026
findings.publisher: United Nations OCHA occupied Palestinian territory
findings.affected_population_system: Humanitarian Coordinator launched a $40 million oPt Humanitarian Fund allocation on November 16, of which $36 million is designated for Gaza, including shelter/winterization, water and sanitation, health and food security. Allocation is not evidence of disbursement or delivery. This is distinct from the previously logged UK healthcare funding and winter shelter funding gap.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: comprising $36 million for the Gaza Strip and $4 million for the West Bank
